rules.title: General
rules.description: Roll dice, make choices, no regrets. Rules are guidelines; players may choose differently if they can justify it.

rules.title: Yearly order
rules.description: Generate events → Calculate income → Marriage → Tax and personal expenses → Rent/mortgage → Other expenses → Debt. Add what's left to savings or debt → Calculate savings and debt accumulation

rules.title: Minimum-wage job
rules.description: $38,000/year; automatic success.

rules.title: Advanced Minimum-wage job
rules.description: Roll 6 to earn $48,000/year.

rules.title: Career job
rules.description: Roll a 1 or 6 to get the job. Required education must be completed.

rules.title: Work and school
rules.description: Until age 25, you may have full-time work or school plus part-time work or school.

rules.title: Marriage income
rules.description: Married players increase their combined income by 25% (income x 1.25).

rules.title: Taxes and Personal expenses
rules.description: 25% Taxes and 35% Personal expenses (food, phone, insurance, gas... etc) of income (Just add the percent to make it easy) (income x .4)

rules.title: Children
rules.description: Each child costs $8,000/year for 18 years.

rules.title: Living at home
rules.description: You may live at home until age 23.

rules.title: Home purchase
rules.description: The minimum down payment is 15%.

rules.title: Home prices guideline
rules.description: Condo: $575,000; townhouse: $835,000; detached: $1,100,000.

rules.title: Mortgage
rules.description: Maximum 25 years at 0% annual interest. Calculate annual payments as (house price - down payment) / payment years.

rules.title: Transportation
rules.description: Public transit is free; the minimum car purchase price is $5,000.

rules.title: Education
rules.description: Post-secondary education costs $8,000/year.

rules.title: Savings
rules.description: Savings earn 5% annually (multiply by 1.05).

rules.title: Debt
rules.description: Debt accrues 10% interest annually (multiply by 1.1).

rules.title: Debt versus savings
rules.description: After expenses, choose how much money to put toward debt; the rest goes to savings.

rules.title: Selling a house
rules.description: When you sell your house, you receive 75% of its equity (house value - remaining mortgage) * .75.

rules.title: Divorce
rules.description: If you divorce, lose 50% of your savings and $5,000.

rules.title: Marriage
rules.description: Roll Even to get married.

events.title: Car crash
events.description: Watch out! Your car is totaled. Roll a 4: you manage to save it, that was close.

events.title: Lottery Win
events.description: You bought the right ticket at the right time. Add 1,000 x your roll to income.

events.title: Unexpected Inheritance
events.description: Great-Uncle Bob apparently liked you more than everyone else. Gain $15,000. Roll a 1: Oops, it was only $2,500.

events.title: Found Money
events.description: You check an old account and discover money you forgot existed. Gain $10,000. Roll a 2: Sorry that was in yen $1,000

events.title: Tax Refund
events.description: Apparently you gave the government too much money. Gain $10,000. Roll a 3: they kept it. Somehow.

events.title: Side Hustle
events.description: Your questionable idea actually makes money. Gain $10,000. Roll a 4: More questions then money $1000.

events.title: Lucky Break
events.description: Right place, right time. Gain $5,000. Roll a 5: you were almost lucky. Nothing happens.

events.title: Garage Treasure
events.description: You find something valuable buried under 15 years of junk. Gain $5,000. Roll a 6: just garbage. Lots and lots of garbage.

events.title: Old Investment
events.description: That thing you bought years ago actually went up. Gain $5,000. Roll a 1: you sold too early. Nothing happens.

events.title: Car Sale
events.description: Someone really wants your old car. Gain $5,000. Roll a 2: they changed their mind.

events.title: Bonus!
events.description: Your boss noticed you actually showed up to work. Gain $5,000. Roll a 3: your boss noticed. That's it.

events.title: Home Repair
events.description: Your roof has decided that it doesn't like being a roof anymore. Lose $5,000. Roll a 4: you caught it before it got expensive.

events.title: Car Repair
events.description: The check-engine light has evolved into a check-bank-account light. Lose $5,000. Roll a 5: it was just the gas cap. You're saved.

events.title: Vet Bill
events.description: Your pet has discovered the most expensive way possible to be sick. Lose $5,000. Roll a 6: false alarm! Your pet is fine.

events.title: Bad Investment
events.description: It sounded like a great idea at the time. It wasn't. Lose $5,000. Roll a 1: you got out just in time.

events.title: Oops, That's Broken
events.description: You broke something that was working perfectly yesterday. Lose $5,000. Roll a 2: you fixed it yourself. Somehow.

events.title: Emergency Expense
events.description: Life has presented you with an invoice. Lose $10,000. Roll a 3: insurance actually covered it.

events.title: Car Trouble
events.description: The mechanic says, 'Well... that's not good.' Lose $10,000. Roll a 4: it was only a loose wire.

events.title: Lawsuit
events.description: Congratulations! You're involved in a legal dispute. Lose $10,000. Roll a 5: you settle it without paying.

events.title: Roof Leak
events.description: It's raining inside now. That's generally considered bad. Lose $10,000. Roll a 6: your insurance saves you.

events.title: Medical Bill
events.description: You're fine! Your bank account isn't. Lose $10,000. Roll a 1: your insurance covers it.

events.title: Terrible Investment
events.description: You were promised guaranteed returns. They forgot to mention the guaranteed part was the loss. Lose $10,000. Roll a 2: you listened to your gut and didn't invest.

events.title: Major Repair
events.description: The thing you hoped wouldn't break has broken. Lose $25,000. Roll a 3: you found a cheap fix. Lose $5,000 instead.

events.title: Financial Disaster
events.description: Everything that could go wrong financially decided to happen at once. Lose $25,000. Roll a 4: you dodge the worst of it. Lose $5,000.

events.title: The Expensive Mistake
events.description: 'How much could it possibly cost?' Famous last words. Lose $25,000. Roll a 5: lose $10,000 instead.

events.title: Oops, A Baby
events.description: Positive! Probably! Add 1 child. Roll a 6: false alarm! No baby.

events.title: Unexpected Baby
events.description: The family just got a little bigger. Add 1 child. Roll a 1: false alarm! No baby.

events.title: Baby Fever
events.description: You thought you were done. Apparently, your partner wasn't. Add 1 child. Roll a 2: you talked them out of it.

events.title: Love at First Sight
events.description: You met someone who doesn't immediately run away after hearing about your finances. Use once to get married any time.

events.title: The Big Question
events.description: You popped the question. They said yes! Probably. Use once to get married any time.

events.title: Cheater!
events.description: Your partner catches you. Get divorced. Roll a 3: you went to counseling and worked it out.

events.title: We Need to Talk
events.description: You knew it wasn't going to be good when they started with those four words. Get divorced. Roll a 4: you work things out.

events.title: The Job Interview
events.description: Somehow they didn't notice you have no idea what you're doing. Use once to get a career.

events.title: Right Place, Right Time
events.description: Your friend knows a guy who knows a guy. Use once to get a career.

events.title: Layoffs!
events.description: Corporate says you're 'part of the family.' Then they fire you. Lose your job. Roll a 5: you made the cut.

events.title: Fired!
events.description: 'We're going in a different direction.' That direction apparently doesn't include you. Lose your job. Roll a 6: you talk your way out of it.

events.title: Boss From Hell
events.description: You finally snap after your boss sends another email marked 'URGENT.'. Lose your job. Roll a 1: you tough it out.

events.title: The Company Closed
events.description: Your workplace is gone. Unfortunately, so is your paycheck. Lose your job. Roll a 2: you transfer to another location.

events.title: Monday Morning
events.description: You wake up and realize you absolutely cannot do this job for another 30 years. Lose your job. Roll a 3: coffee fixes everything.

events.title: I Quit!
events.description: You hand in your resignation with absolutely no plan whatsoever. Lose your job. Roll a 4: you realize you need the money and take it back.

events.title: Career Crisis
events.description: You stare at your career and think, 'Is this really it?' Leave your career field PERMANENTLY. Roll a 5: you decide to stick with it.

events.title: Tripped
events.description: You trip over a slightly raised piece of concrete. Lose this year's income. Roll a 6: 'Tis but a scratch.'

events.title: Bad Luck
events.description: You somehow manage to injure yourself doing something completely normal. Lose this year's income. Roll a 1: you're fine. Somehow.

events.title: Stay in Bed
events.description: Nothing can happen if you stay in bed all year. Use once to get out of one event.

events.title: Second Chance
events.description: Pretend it never happened. Use once to get out of one event.

events.title: Win a Car!
events.description: Congratulations! You now own a vehicle you didn't pay for. Gain a car. Roll a 2: the dealership calls. It was a clerical error.

events.title: Car Giveaway
events.description: You entered a contest for a car and somehow actually won. Gain a car. Roll a 3: you were the runner-up.

events.title: Car Theft
events.description: You go outside and discover your car has gone on an unscheduled vacation. Lose your car. Roll a 4: you find it parked three blocks away.

events.title: Car Crash
events.description: You and your car had a disagreement with another vehicle. Lose your car. Roll a 5: it can be repaired.

events.title: Engine Explodes
events.description: Your car has decided it would rather be a very expensive lawn ornament. Lose your car. Roll a 6: who doesnt have an extra engine in there back yard?

events.title: Where's My Car?
events.description: You definitely parked it here... right? Lose your car. Roll a 1: you find it. You just forgot where you parked.

events.title: The Mechanic
events.description: 'It's going to be cheaper to buy another car.' Lose your car. Roll a 2: It wasn't.

events.title: Scholarship!
events.description: Someone looked at your tuition bill and decided to save you from it. Use for one free year of education.

events.title: Free Tuition
events.description: Somehow, you found the magical phrase 'fully funded.'. Use for one free year of education.

events.title: Bankruptcy
events.description: You have officially entered financial 'oops.' Debt becomes $0, but you cannot buy a house or car for 3 years. Roll a 5: you dont qualify for bankruptcy.

events.title: Promotion!
events.description: Your boss finally realizes that replacing you would be difficult. Income increases by $3,000/year. Roll a 6: your boss says 'maybe next year.'

events.title: Forced Sale
events.description: The bank, circumstances, or life itself says it's time to move. Sell your house. Roll a 1: you manage to keep it.

events.title: Noticed Your Hard Work
events.description: You've been doing your job well enough that someone finally noticed (yeah right). Income increases by $4,000/year. Roll a 2: your boss gives you a pizza party instead.

events.title: The Brown-Noser
events.description: You brought your boss coffee for 4,245 consecutive days. It worked. Income increases by $2,000/year. Roll a 3: your boss starts asking for cream and sugar too. No raise.

events.title: House Flipper
events.description: You sell your house at the perfect time. You can choose to sell your house and receive 110% of the equity.

events.title: Influencer Moment
events.description: You post one mildly funny video and the algorithm decides you're famous for 48 hours. Gain $5,000. Roll a 1: it was just your mom and three bots.

events.title: Cryptocurrency Rollercoaster
events.description: You finally check that bitcoin wallet from 2019. Gain $5,000. Roll a 2: it's worth $0.37 and a single meme coin named after a potato.

events.title: Neighbor's Leftovers
events.description: Your neighbor moves out and leaves behind a suspiciously nice grill. Gain $2,000 in free stuff. Roll a 3: the grill is haunted.

events.title: Viral Coupon
events.description: You find a coupon that actually works. Gain $3,000 in free merchandise. Roll a 4: the store closed three years ago.

events.title: Freelance Win
events.description: Someone pays you actual money for that thing you do on the side. Gain $4,000. Roll a 5: they pay in 'exposure' and a handshake.

events.title: Appliance Rebellion
events.description: Your fridge has decided to become a very expensive paperweight. Lose $3,000. Roll a 6: it just needed a stern talking-to.

events.title: Plumbing Adventure
events.description: Water is coming out of places water should not come out of. Lose $4,000. Roll a 1: it was just a clog. A very dramatic clog.

events.title: Identity Theft (Almost)
events.description: Someone tried to open accounts in your name. Lose $5,000. Roll a 2: the bank catches it first.

events.title: Gym Membership Trap
events.description: You forgot to cancel. Again. Lose $1,000. Roll a 3: you actually go once and feel slightly less guilty.

events.title: Subscription Avalanche
events.description: You discover you're paying for 14 streaming services and a monthly sock club. Lose $2,000. Roll a 4: you cancel all of them in a fit of rage.

events.title: Wedding Guest Tax
events.description: Three friends get married in the same year. Your wallet weeps. Lose $4,000. Roll a 5: you give them a heartfelt card and a plant.

events.title: Pet Drama
events.description: Your pet has developed expensive taste in furniture. Lose $3,000. Roll a 6: the couch was already ugly anyway.

events.title: Family Reunion
events.description: Aunt Carol has opinions about your life choices and also needs a place to stay. Lose $2,000 in groceries and dignity. Roll a 1: she leaves early.

events.title: Squirrel Incident
events.description: A squirrel has declared war on your attic. Lose $2,000. Roll a 2: the squirrel loses. The attic wins...?

events.title: Parking Ticket Empire
events.description: The city has decided you are its favorite customer. Lose $1,000. Roll a 3: you successfully argue one of them down to a warning.

events.title: Sudden Hobby
events.description: You discover a new passion that requires specialized equipment and a surprising amount of money. Lose $4,000. Roll a 4: you quit after two weeks like a normal person.

events.title: The Great Bake-Off
events.description: You enter a local baking contest for fun. Gain $1,000 and mild local fame. Roll a 5: your cake collapses in a way that becomes a meme.

events.title: Jury Duty
events.description: You have been selected for the privilege of sitting in a room and not working. Lose this year's income. Roll a 6: you get dismissed on day one.

events.title: Haunted House Hunt
events.description: You buy a 'charming fixer-upper.' It has opinions. Lose $10,000 in unexpected repairs. Roll a 1: the previous owners left a hidden safe with enough money to cover repairs.

events.title: Online Auction Victory
events.description: You win something cool for a suspiciously low price. Gain $2,000 in value. Roll a 2: shipping costs more than the item.

events.title: Food Delivery Curse
events.description: You order takeout every night for a month. Lose $2,000. Roll a 4: one of the drivers becomes your friend and gives you free fries.

events.title: Accidental Expert
events.description: People start asking you for advice on something you only know a little about. Gain $2,000 consulting. Roll a 5: someone figures out you're just winging it.

events.title: Storm Damage
events.description: Nature has opinions about your property. Lose $8,000. Roll a 6: insurance actually pays without a 6-month fight.

events.title: The Mysterious Package
events.description: A package arrives with your name on it. You didn't order it. Gain a $1,000 mystery item. Roll a 1: it's someone else's and they want it back. Awkward.

events.title: Career Pivot Attempt
events.description: You try to switch work places mid-year. Income increases by $5,000/year. Roll a 2: They don't want you

events.title: The Group Project of Life
events.description: You're stuck coordinating something with people who don't check their messages. Lose $1,000 and 3 years of patience. Roll a 3: someone else finally steps up.

events.title: Lucky Parking Spot
events.description: You find a perfect parking spot right in front. Gain $0 but feel like a god. Roll a 4: you get a ticket anyway because the meter was broken.

events.title: Inheritance of Junk
events.description: A distant relative leaves you their entire collection of... things. Gain $4,000 after selling most of it. Roll a 5: it's all worthless. But you now own 200 commemorative plates.

events.title: The Awkward Reunion
events.description: You run into your high school nemesis who is somehow doing better than you. Lose $1000 in impulsive 'self-improvement' purchases. Roll a 6: they're actually miserable and you feel better for free.

events.title: DIY Disaster
events.description: You watched one video and decided you could fix it yourself. Lose $2,000. Roll a 1: it somehow works. You become insufferable about it.

events.title: Spam Call Victory
events.description: You waste 20 minutes of a scammer's time. Gain pure satisfaction and $0. Roll a 2: they somehow still get $1000 out of you. How?

events.title: Office Snack Tax
events.description: You keep eating the good snacks and someone finally notices. Lose $1000 in forced office contributions. Roll a 3: you become the new snack buyer. Power.

events.title: Weather App Betrayal
events.description: You trusted the forecast. It lied. Lose $1,000 in ruined outdoor plans and emergency supplies. Roll a 4: it was sunny the whole time and you just had a smudge on your glasses.

events.title: The Forgotten Gift Card
events.description: You find a gift card from three years ago with money still on it. Gain $1000. Roll a 5: it expired last week. Of course.

events.title: Roommate Roulette
events.description: Your roommate moves out with zero notice. Lose $3,000 covering their share. Roll a 6: they left behind a really nice TV as apology.

events.title: Public Speaking Nightmare
events.description: You get volunteered to give a presentation. Survive and gain $2,000 in 'professional development.' Roll a 1: you freeze completely.

events.title: The Eternal Waitlist
events.description: You finally get off a waitlist for something cool. Gain $1,000 value experience. Roll a 2: it's sold out the moment you try to claim it.

events.title: Mildly Successful Side Project
events.description: That thing you built 'just for fun' makes a little money. Gain $6,000. Roll a 3: it makes exactly enough to cover the domain name for another year.

events.title: The Final Boss of Adulting
events.description: You successfully complete a full year of adult responsibilities without a major crisis. Gain $5,000 and a deep sense of unease that something is about to go wrong. Roll a 4: something immediately goes wrong.

events.title: Hot Market
events.description: The housing market is temporarily insane. You can choose to sell your house and receive 110% of the equity.

events.title: Desperate Buyer
events.description: Someone really, really wants your house. You can choose to sell your house and receive 115% of the equity.

events.title: Quiet Raise
events.description: They slid a little extra into your paycheck and hoped you wouldn't make a big deal out of it. Income increases by $5,000/year. Roll a 1: it was just an error.

events.title: Performance Review Win
events.description: You somehow survived the annual review with a smile. Income increases by $4,000/year. Roll a 2: they give you a 'great job' email instead.

events.title: Market Adjustment
events.description: Your company finally noticed the cost of living exists. Income increases by $3,000/year. Roll a 3: they adjusted it by giving everyone free coffee.

events.title: Skill Premium
events.description: You learned one useful thing and they paid you for it. Income increases by $2,000/year. Roll a 4: they just put it on your LinkedIn for you.

events.title: Loyalty Bonus
events.description: You've stayed long enough that leaving would be annoying for them. Income increases by $2,000/year. Roll a 5: they give you a mug that says 'Team Player'.

events.title: Cost of Living Bump
events.description: A tiny raise to keep you from updating your resume. Income increases by $2,000/year. Roll a 6: it barely covers the new parking fee.

events.title: Almost a Raise
events.description: They wanted to give you more. The budget said no. Income increases by $1,000/year. Roll a 1: just a firm handshake.

events.title: Token Increase
events.description: The absolute smallest raise they could give without looking mean. Income increases by $1,000/year. Roll a 2: they call it 'professional development.'

events.title: Existential Stare
events.description: You spend an entire afternoon staring at a wall questioning every decision that led you here. Nothing happens. You just feel weird now.

events.title: Group Chat Chaos
events.description: You get added to a group chat of 47 people who all type in all caps. Nothing financially changes.

events.title: Mildly Spicy Takeout
events.description: You ordered 'medium' and received 'why is my face on fire.' Gain nothing except temporary regret and a story.

events.title: Caught Red-Handed
events.description: Your partner found the secret second phone. Get divorced. Roll a 1: it was just for work. Somehow they believe you.

events.title: Irreconcilable Differences
events.description: You both realized you hate the same things... including each other. Get divorced. Roll a 2: couples therapy buys you another year.

events.title: The Texts Came Out
events.description: Someone forwarded the group chat. Get divorced. Roll a 3: you convince them it was 'just banter.'

events.title: Separate Vacations Forever
events.description: You booked two completely different trips and never looked back. Get divorced. Roll a 4: you both apologize and awkwardly continue.

events.title: Surprise Bundle
events.description: The test came back with more lines than expected. Add 1 child. Roll a 5: false positive. Huge sigh of relief.

events.title: Oopsie Daisy
events.description: Well... that was not part of the five-year plan. Add 1 child. Roll a 6: it was a very realistic dream.

events.title: The Plot Twist
events.description: Life just hit you with the ultimate expansion pack. Add 1 child. Roll a 1: the doctor mixed up the charts.

events.title: Gone in 60 Seconds
events.description: You stepped inside for one second. Your car did not. Lose your car. Roll a 2: it was towed, not stolen. Still expensive.

events.title: Totaled Beyond Recognition
events.description: Someone scratched your car. The decided this was the end. Lose your car. Roll a 3: you buff it out. Barely.

events.title: Flooded Engine
events.description: You drove through that puddle like a champion. Your car disagreed. Lose your car. Roll a 4: it just needs a drying out.

events.title: Back Injury
events.description: You sneezed wrong. Lose this year's income. Roll a 5: it was just a weird muscle cramp.

events.title: Mystery Illness
events.description: The doctor says 'we've never seen this before' and then bills you. Lose this year's income. Roll a 6: it was just stress. Expensive stress.

events.title: Broken Wrist
events.description: You tripped over absolutely nothing. Lose this year's income. Roll a 1: it's only a sprain. You're back next week. Yay?

events.title: Burnout Collapse
events.description: Your body finally filed a formal complaint. Lose this year's income. Roll a 2: a long weekend somehow fixes it.

events.title: Forced Bed Rest
events.description: Doctor's orders: do absolutely nothing productive for a year. Lose this year's income. Roll a 3: you ignore the doctor and go back early.

events.title: Restructuring
events.description: They restructured the company right out from under you. Lose your job. Roll a 4: they find you a new seat at the table.

events.title: Budget Cuts
events.description: The company needs to 'tighten its belt.' Your job was the belt. Lose your job. Roll a 5: they cut the snack budget instead.

events.title: New Management
events.description: The new boss brought their own people. You were not one of them. Lose your job. Roll a 6: they keep you because you know where the files are.

events.title: Performance Improvement Plan
events.description: They put you on a PIP. Everyone knows what that means. Lose your job. Roll a 1: you actually improve and survive.

events.title: The Merger
events.description: Two companies became one. Your position became zero. Lose your job. Roll a 2: they offer you a different role at the same pay.

events.title: Chapter 7 Reality
events.description: The numbers finally stopped working. Debt becomes $0, but you cannot buy a house or car for 3 years. Roll a 3: the judge says you're not quite broke enough.

events.title: Financial Reset Button
events.description: You officially hit the big red button. Debt becomes $0, but you cannot buy a house or car for 3 years. Roll a 4: you find a way to claw back some dignity and assets.

events.title: Industry Exit
events.description: You burn every bridge in your field on the way out. Leave your career PERMANENTLY and cannot return to that field. Roll a 5: It was just a nightmare... or dream?

events.title: Blacklisted
events.description: Word got around. Leave your career PERMANENTLY and cannot return to that field. Roll a 6: the rumors were only half true.

events.title: Scandal
events.description: Something very public and very stupid happened. Leave your career PERMANENTLY and cannot return to that field. Roll a 1: it blows over in a month.

events.title: Burned Out Forever
events.description: You never want to see that industry again. Leave your career PERMANENTLY and cannot return to that field. Roll a 2: you miss it and sneak back.

events.title: Ethical Walkout
events.description: You refuse to keep doing the thing. Leave your career PERMANENTLY and cannot return to that field. Roll a 3: they offer you a slightly less evil version of the job.

events.title: Radio Contest Miracle
events.description: You were caller number 9. Gain a car. Roll a 4: it was a bicycle with a very nice paint job.

events.title: Whirlwind Romance
events.description: You met someone and everything moved extremely fast. Use once to get married any time.

events.title: The Proposal That Worked
events.description: You asked. They said yes without laughing. Use once to get married any time.

events.title: Get Out of Jail Free
events.description: You found a cosmic loophole. Use once to skip one event.

events.title: Narrative Edit
events.description: You simply refuse to accept this plot point. Use once to skip one event.

events.title: Divine Intervention
events.description: Something out there likes you today. Use once to skip one event.

events.title: Plot Armor
events.description: The universe has decided this one doesn't count. Use once to skip one event.

events.title: Full Ride... No... Some ride?
events.description: Someone decided your brain was worth investing in. Use for one free year of education.

events.title: Grant Angel
events.description: A grant appeared with your name on it. Use for one free year of education.

events.title: Tuition Vanish
events.description: The bill simply... disappeared. Use for one free year of education.

events.title: Market Correction
events.description: Your industry just got a little less generous. Income decreases by $3,000/year. Roll a 5: it's only temporary.

events.title: Hours Cut
events.description: They reduced your hours and called it 'flexibility.' Income decreases by $2,000/year. Roll a 6: you pick up a small side gig to cover it.

events.title: Benefit Squeeze
events.description: They kept your salary but quietly gutted everything else. Income decreases by $1,000/year. Roll a 1: you negotiate most of it back.

events.title: The Missing Sock Council
events.description: You open the dryer and discover the socks have formed a union. Nothing happens. They just judge you.

events.title: Aggressive Pigeon Stare
events.description: A pigeon locks eyes with you for a full 40 seconds. You lose the staring contest. Gain nothing except existential discomfort.

events.title: Mysterious Fridge Noise
events.description: Your fridge starts making a new sound at 2:17 a.m. every night. Nothing is broken. It just wants attention.

events.title: The Group Chat That Wouldn't Die
events.description: You left the group chat. They made a new one and added you back. Gain nothing. Accept your fate.

events.title: Slightly Crooked Picture Frame
events.description: You notice one picture frame is 2 degrees off. You fix it. Five minutes later it's crooked again. Nothing else happens.

events.title: Tornado.
events.description: A tornado decides it's your house's time. Sell your house. Roll a 1: And that time is not now

events.title: Eminent Domain Surprise
events.description: The city needs your land for a very important project. Sell your house. Roll a 2: they only need your yard.

events.title: Divorce Settlement House
events.description: The paperwork is clear: the house has to go. Sell your house. Roll a 3: you get to keep the good couch.

events.title: Inheritance Condition
events.description: Great-Aunt Mildred's will has one weird requirement: sell the house or lose the rest of the inheritance. Sell your house. Roll a 4: the rest of the inheritance was just more commemorative plates.

events.title: Slipped
events.description: You slipped on something that absolutely should not have been there. Lose this year's income. Roll a 4: you're fine. Your dignity isn't.

events.title: Unexpected Surgery
events.description: Apparently, that thing you've been ignoring actually needed attention. Lose this year's income. Roll a 5: turns out it can wait.

events.title: The Accident
events.description: One moment you're having a normal day. The next, you're filling out paperwork. Lose this year's income. Roll a 6: nothing serious, just a very expensive scare.

events.title: Out for the Year
events.description: Your body has officially requested a sabbatical. Lose this year's income. Roll a 1: you recover much faster than expected.

events.title: You're Fired
events.description: Your boss calls you into the office and closes the door. Lose your job. Roll a 3: they were actually going to offer you a promotion.

events.title: Commission Jackpot
events.description: You closed a deal so big your boss actually smiled. You gain $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Viral Side Hustle
events.description: Your weird little project suddenly pays real money every month. You gain $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Skill Stack Payday
events.description: You stacked just enough random skills that someone decided to pay you properly. You gain $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Quiet Negotiation Win
events.description: You asked for a raise with zero confidence and somehow got it. You gain $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Industry Slowdown
events.description: Your whole field just got a little poorer. You lose $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Hours Quietly Cut
events.description: They reduced your hours and called it 'optimizing resources.' You lose $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Bonus Structure Changed
events.description: The new bonus plan is somehow worse for everyone except upper management. You lose $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Cost-Cutting Measures
events.description: They found savings... mostly in your paycheck. You lose $1,000 x your roll

events.title: Market Correction (Personal Edition)
events.description: Whatever was propping up your pay just stopped. You lose $1,000 x your roll
